summary.text: Tawna Sanchez is a Democratic state representative from Oregon House District 43 in North and Northeast Portland who has served since 2017 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
On her legislative website she lists herself as co-chair of the Joint Committee on Ways and Means.

paragraphs.text: Tawna Sanchez succeeded Lew Frederick in the Oregon House.
On her legislative website, she says she also serves as co-chair of the Joint Committee on Audits and on the Joint Committee on Addiction and Community Safety Response.

Sanchez writes on her legislative website that she has advocated for social justice her entire life and points to her experience as a foster parent and as a co-founder of the Native American Youth and Family Center.
She lists improving the behavioral health system, investing in affordable housing and strengthening early education as her priorities.
